info.name: Narmi Public account balances scheduled transfers API

params.name: is_expired
params.description: When present, will filter results by either expired only, or unexpired only.

params.name: page
params.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

items.docs: List the authenticated user's scheduled transfers. All monetary values are represented in minor units, or the smallest unit of the currency with no decimal (e.g., cents). For example, $10.00 is represented as 1000. How can we improve these docs? Share your feedback.

Create a scheduled transfer for the authenticated user. All monetary values are represented in minor units, or the smallest unit of the currency with no decimal (e.g., cents). For example, $10.00 is represented as 1000. How can we improve these docs? Share your feedback.

Edit a scheduled transfer for the authenticated user. All monetary values are represented in minor units, or the smallest unit of the currency with no decimal (e.g., cents). For example, $10.00 is represented as 1000. How can we improve these docs? Share your feedback.

Delete a user's scheduled transfer. Accepts a payload containing an identifier for the scheduled transfer,
either a Narmi UUID or a core identifier.

Example:
```http
DELETE /v1/transfers/scheduled/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "id": "07231f46-23f1-482e-bdc4-35f2267b60e6"
}

```

All monetary values are represented in minor units, or the smallest unit of the currency with no decimal (e.g., cents). For example, $10.00 is represented as 1000.
